text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaahhhh!! Th-Thank yoooou 
booooth~~~~!! I'm s-s-sooo haaaaappyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Today, we have a presentation for you. 
Entitled: 'A Heart-Throbbing, Charming 
Birthday to Bring Out Ticket's Brand-New 
Charm'!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Here is what we propose! Ticket-san 
looking mature and cool in Italian-style 
elegant fashion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You went through all the trouble of 
thinking of this for meeeEEEEE! Thaaank 
you sooo mu—huh? W-Wait, me in such a cool 
outfit...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's quite a departure from my usual 
look, but—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Skinny jeans with a classy white jacket, 
accented by a crisp, vibrant scarf... I 
just know Ticket-san could totally pull 
that offâª

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I generally oppose cheap gap-moe tropes, 
but this is a flawless gap construct built 
upon meticulous calculation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Dressed so maturely, yet flashing that 
innocent smile so characteristic of 
Ticket-san... Operation: Heart-Throb 
Mach-Speed Heart-Stealer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-whaaat?! No way! Heart-throbbing at 
mach speed...? Me...? R-Reallyyy??

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's sure to look amazing on you! 
Let's go get changed right away♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let us have a photoshoot as well. It is 
bound to blow up massively! Come now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaaat... I-I mean... I'm happy, but 
it's so embarrassing~~...!
